en.headline: Victoria Park lantern display lights up for a final night
en.dek: The Tourism Board's International Mid-Autumn Lantern Spectacular, extended through the National Day holiday, ends on Wednesday, with lights from 6.30pm to 11pm.
body: The Hong Kong Tourism Board's International Mid-Autumn Lantern Spectacular at Victoria Park reaches its last night on Wednesday. The board extended every lantern display to 7 October so that it would cover the National Day holiday.

Lighting is from 6.30pm to 11pm. The board said the displays, which opened on 17 September, drew about 580,000 visits in the 13 days to 29 September, an average of about 45,000 a day, with a single-day peak of more than 200,000. The show gathers festival lanterns from 20 countries, alongside large lanterns made with Nanjing craft.

The Leisure and Cultural Services Department also extended its Mid-Autumn Lantern Carnival at the same park to 7 October, citing visitor numbers. The Tourism Board said it would apply crowd controls if needed and asked visitors to follow staff directions.
The park is at 1 Hing Fat Street, Causeway Bay.

zh.headline: 維園國際中秋綵燈匯今晚最後一夜亮燈
zh.dek: 旅發局展覽延長至周三，涵蓋國慶假期，亮燈時間為下午6時半至晚上11時。康文署維園中秋綵燈會展期同樣延至今日。
body: 香港旅遊發展局在維多利亞公園舉行的國際中秋綵燈匯，周三踏入最後一晚。旅發局早前宣布所有綵燈展覽延長至10月7日，以涵蓋國慶黃金周。
亮燈時間為下午6時半至晚上11時。旅發局表示，展覽9月17日開展，至9月29日的13天內錄得約58萬人次，平均每日約4萬5千人次，單日最高超過20萬人次。場內有來自20個國家的節慶綵燈，以及以南京工藝製作的大型綵燈。
康樂及文化事務署亦因遊人多，把同在維園舉行的中秋綵燈會展期延長至10月7日。旅發局表示，會視乎人流按需要實施人流管理，並呼籲參觀人士遵從現場工作人員指示。
維多利亞公園位於銅鑼灣興發街1號。
